question: Is GS DAF's August 2008 Program Circular still the operative public version? Search GS PWM disclosure sites (gsbrandguidelines.com, goldman.com/web/philanthropy) and any later 990 Schedule O text for a post-2008 circular, and confirm the 2026 grant rail (check only?), transfer-out and export terms
conclusion_affected: A3 GS PF Y2/Y5 (now U because the only terms are 17 years old)
rationale: The live 2026 iPhi donor web binds users to 'GS DAF's Program Circular' without dating it; the only public copy is dated August 2008 and pays grants by check. Scoring 2026 capability from it would break the bounded-truth rule

question: Which Ren-administered sponsors share Ren's 'sign up for ACH once' charity network (AEF confirmed Q2 2026; MS GIFT, RCF, others?), and does BofA CGF, whose 2024-25 terms are check-only, take part? Use Ren and sponsor charity pages, grant letters posted by nonprofits and QR-code enrolment pages
conclusion_affected: A2 Ren RDE X1/X4; A3 Y2 for MS GIFT and BofA; rail map
rationale: Ren claims one ACH enrolment covers every DAF program it supports, but names none. AEF's charity page is the only sponsor confirmation; MS GIFT claims ACH without naming a provider; BofA (Ren portal) says checks only

question: Do Ren DFX sponsor portals (BofA CGF, MS GIFT, others on donorfirst.org/donorfirstx.com) offer grant-history export, and is the Excel export shown in BofA's 2025 portal guide available on the grant listing as well as the contribution listing? Use publicly posted portal guides only
conclusion_affected: A3 Y1/Y5 for BofA and MS GIFT; A1 Ren Y1 (entity-scoped)
rationale: BofA's 2025 DFX guide documents Excel export of contributions only; MS GIFT's circular describes viewing statements only. Y5 level 3 needs a history export

question: Census of grant-payment rails at the 30 largest community foundations by DAF assets: own ACH, Chariot, PayPal Grant Payments, Ren, or check only; with enrolment requirements and whether DAF grants (not only competitive grants) are covered
conclusion_affected: Rail map; A2 provider footprint (Chariot, PayPal); nonprofit cost of checks
rationale: This pass found public ACH pages at Greater Houston, Oregon and Greater New Haven, and seven smaller foundations on Chariot's partner list, but nothing for SVCF, Chicago CT or JCF. The community-foundation segment of the rail map is anecdotal

question: Is PayPal Grant Payments still used by NPT and Vanguard in 2026 after Charityvest moved to Chariot (Aug 2026), and have any new sponsors joined? Check sponsor nonprofit pages, PayPal newsroom and 990 Part VII-B/Schedule O payment-processor mentions
rationale: PayPal's current partner page names no sponsors; the only lists are 2023 (NPT, Vanguard, Charityvest); Chariot lists 'PayPal Grant Payments' only as a managed source
